title: From Heat to Homology: Spectral Gap Transfer for Exact Quantum Gibbs Sampling at All Temperatures
summary: Preparing Gibbs states through dissipative dynamics requires controlling convergence for the chosen Hamiltonian $H$ and coupling operators. However, efficient implementation requires convergence guarantees from the spectral gap of the generator of the dynamics, which remains a crucial challenge. Recent results address the challenge by restricting the dynamics with structural assumptions about the Hamiltonian and its interactions.
